instruction: A cinematic medium shot of a festive outdoor patio. In the center foreground, the woman in the pink dress (R4) with a pink flower in her hair smiles joyfully while facing forward. Directly behind her, the man in the white dress shirt (R3) leans in to kiss her neck with his eyes closed. They hold hands intimately in front. In the background, a blurred mariachi guitarist wearing a sombrero plays his acoustic guitar. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene, creating a warm, celebratory atmosphere with gentle shadows.
